title: Project configuration
description: What the whole team shares about this control repository: its integration branch (and its remote, when the URL may be tracked), the demo dates and tag prefix, the team's links and the default AWS region. Tracked; what differs per machine goes in local.yaml. A value that starts with REPLACE-WITH- is a placeholder and counts as unset.

remote.description: Git URL of this control repository. Optional: a team whose URL must not be tracked sets control_remote in local.yaml instead, which overrides this. Once set, check.py and doctor.py report a checkout whose origin differs.

github.description: The control repository on GitHub, as <org>/<repo>, for gh commands. Optional; control_github in local.yaml overrides it.

integration_branch.description: The control repository's integration branch. Supplies the integration_branch key below the plugin option.

freeze.description: The code freeze, YYYY-MM-DD, quoted; only hotfix phases merge after it.

tag_prefix.description: Prefix of the demo release tags, such as demo- for demo-rc-1 and demo-final.

region.description: The team's default AWS region. Supplies the aws_region key below the plugin option; local.yaml overrides it per machine.
